distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) supports occurrence in 云南. Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Taiwan occurrence; this source entry does not list a direct Taiwan locality in the locality field, but its occurrence treatment is affirmative rather than doubtful.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) provides the explicit host list retained in the current synthesis. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes broad polyphagy on angiosperm trees and lianes and notes bamboo originating from Taiwan; this broad prose is retained as context and not expanded into inferred host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus javanus (Eggers, 1908).
